home.subtitle: Devices, signals and capture apps in one workspace.
device.title: Device connection
device.mapping_note: Configure channel positions for the actual electrode placement.
device.serial_note: The serial port is scanned automatically. Close OpenBCI GUI if it owns the dongle.
live.subtitle: A temporary signal-display test. It never writes to the production EEG database.
live.test_mode: Acquisition test mode · In-memory test signal only · Production EEG database is not written
live.display: Dynamic window 5 s   ·   Scale ±100 μV   ·   Display filter 1–50 Hz / 50 Hz
live.filter_note: The waveform is generated for UI verification only; no production EEG data is written.
live.status: In-memory test mode · Production EEG database is not written
apps.subtitle: Open a capture task just like an app.
apps.flow: SSVEP: setup → real 5-second preparation → full-screen stimulus/demo → dataset.
dataset_summary.title: Dataset summary
dataset_summary.readonly: Read-only summary. Original OpenBCI files were not modified, and no participant or experiment metadata was invented.
dataset_summary.data_preview_note: Read-only first 100 rows. The complete raw file is not loaded or modified; choose another raw shard to inspect it.
ssvep.subtitle: Steady-state visual evoked potentials · Four-target screen stimulation
ssvep.description: Follow each target cue while recording eight EEG channels and stimulus events. Visit targets in sequence for each repetition.
ssvep.safety: Photosensitivity notice: full-screen visual preview, synthetic, and Cyton modes flash and may cause discomfort. People with photosensitive epilepsy or related history should not participate. Press Esc or Q immediately if uncomfortable. The default workflow demo does not flash.
ssvep.defaults: Defaults are ready: P001 · SSVEP · 5 s stimulus · 3 s rest · 3 repetitions per target · 60 Hz · saved automatically under NeuroStation/Datasets. Click Start to run the workflow demo.
field.name: Dataset name
field.port_auto: AUTO scans ports at start and tries each one; an explicit COM/device path is also supported.
field.port_detected: Detected ports: {ports}. Start will verify which one is the Cyton dongle.
field.port_none: No serial port detected yet. Connect the USB dongle and scan again, or start for diagnostics.
field.channel_auto: Use the default CH1–CH8 board channel mapping
field.channel_manual: Advanced: specify a channel configuration JSON
field.channel_manual_placeholder: Enable Advanced to choose JSON; the default needs no file
ssvep.refresh_note: 60 Hz is illustrative. Production acquisition must measure refresh timing and validate frame schedules.
ssvep.formula: Total = 5-second preparation + stimuli + inter-trial rests. No rest after the last trial.
ssvep.countdown_note: Start begins a real 5-second countdown. Acceleration applies only to the simulated recording.
ssvep.acknowledge: I have read the photosensitivity notice and can abort with Esc / Q
ssvep.allow_draft: Technical validation only: allow draft protocol or incomplete channel map
ssvep.production: Production task uses full-screen stimuli. This UI prototype remains static.
task.prepare_note: Get comfortable and prepare to look at the cued target.
task.capture.demo: Workflow demo · No device · No EEG samples
task.capture.preview: Full-screen visual preview · No device · No EEG samples
task.capture.synthetic: BrainFlow synthetic capture · 16 EEG CH / 250 Hz · Raw data persisted
task.capture.cyton: OpenBCI Cyton capture · 8 CH / 250 Hz · Raw data persisted
task.realtime: Real-time execution · Full-screen stimulus · Planned recording: {duration}
task.cancelled: Task cancelled. If the acquisition worker had started, partial data is preserved in the dataset directory.
result.title: Capture task completed
result.error_title: Capture task ended with an error
result.synthetic_saved: Complete · BrainFlow synthetic raw data saved
result.cyton_saved: Complete · OpenBCI Cyton raw data saved
result.preview_saved: Complete · full-screen visual preview metadata saved
result.preview_notice: Full-screen visual preview completed; no device was connected and no real EEG samples were produced.
result.capture_test_notice: The acquisition test completed. The waveform existed only in memory; no production EEG database or disk file was written.
result.aborted_saved: Aborted · Partial acquisition data safely saved
result.error_saved: Error · Recoverable data and diagnostics saved
result.notice: Simulation completed. Counts are calculated; no device data or files were created.
result.notice_written: Simulation completed. Protocol, events, and session manifest were saved; no real EEG samples were recorded.
result.recorded_notice: The acquisition worker saved raw board data, events, protocol, frame timing, session metadata, and a verification manifest. Synthetic-board data is not real EEG.
result.capture_test_path: Acquisition test result (in memory only; not written)
result.capture_test_memory: In-memory test result only; no file or database record was created
result.path_written: Absolute path containing saved session metadata
datasets.subtitle: Sessions and app results are collected in the workstation.
datasets.empty: No datasets yet. Complete a simulated task to see it here.

users.demo_protected: The demo user is protected and cannot be deleted.
users.search_placeholder: Filter by user ID or name

validation.identity: Enter a participant ID and dataset name.
validation.user_age: Age must be an integer from 0 to 150.
validation.user_medical: Choose at least one medical-history option.
validation.user_medical_none: None cannot be selected with another condition.
validation.user_medical_other: Add notes when Other is selected.
validation.user_id_duplicate: That user ID already exists or is still in the recycle bin.
validation.user_not_found: The acquisition user does not exist or is in the recycle bin.
validation.user_demo: The demo user is only for workflow demos and cannot be used for formal acquisition.
validation.parameters: Use stimulus 1–30 s, rest 0–30 s, and repetitions 1–10.
validation.path: Choose an absolute directory path on this computer.
validation.refresh: The mock currently supports the illustrative 60 Hz screen only.
validation.speed: Simulation speed must be between 1× and 32×.
validation.production_speed: Synthetic and Cyton acquisition must run at 1× real time.
validation.port: Use AUTO to scan ports, or enter a path such as COM5 or /dev/cu.usbserial-*.
validation.screen: Choose a valid stimulus screen index.
validation.flicker_ack: Acknowledge the photosensitivity notice before full-screen flashing.
validation.channel_path: The channel configuration must be an absolute path.
validation.channel_missing: The Cyton channel configuration file does not exist. Create and review the final channel map.
validation.worker_start: The acquisition worker could not be started.
validation.worker_failed: The acquisition worker exited unexpectedly. Check the device, port, channel map, and log.
validation.busy: Stop or cancel the active task before starting another one.
validation.manual_marker: Manual markers require an active manual recording.
validation.manual_stop: There is no active manual recording to stop.
validation.openbci_unavailable: OpenBCI GUI has not been built or configured. Build the locked source first.
